Mx_negative.ULS_pure_effort_role: Pure-component polygon line/offset-face normalization only; NOT a design resistance.
Mx_negative.coefficient_origin: Original gross centroid; coefficients multiply SIGNED physical Mx.
Mx_negative.effective_centroid_property_origin: Original pinned polygon coordinates; pure-Mx coefficients use gross-centred coordinates and N=My=0.
Mx_negative.fixed_point_statement: Final local reduced section gives exactly min(1, chi_d*fyb/(gammaM0*sigma_As))=1. Retaining full As thickness therefore leaves section, stress field and ratio unchanged; local widths remain the prescribed gross-psi step-1 widths.
Mx_negative.local_flange_basis: EN13 5.5.2(3) gross psi=1, initial uniform fyb/gammaM0 local bound. No optional psi refinement. Final full physical compressed flange and lip lie below this bound.
Mx_negative.proof: EN1993-1-3 5.5.2(3), 5.5.3.1 Eq5.10b/5.12, 5.5.3.2 Eq5.17 and 6.1.4.1; EN1993-1-5 4.4/Table4.1. Gross psi flange widths, final web/lip/As domains, exact Eq5.17 cap=1. Full effective inertia inversion with Ixy and c0, N=My=0. No service-stress law or optional refinements.
Mx_negative.pure_moment_explanation: N=My=0 by complete section inversion. Centroid shift is already in c0; no extra N*e is introduced for this pure moment.
Mx_negative.scope: Pinned Ue100x50x17 t1.20, ri=t, E210000, fyb=fya250, nu0.3, gammaM0=1. Polygon dA=t*ds only. No NBR whole-member approval, global stability, shear/torsion/warping, connections, solid fibre resistance or new material/geometries.

stiffeners.Eq5_17_reference: Pure-component ULS field, max absolute retained line/offset-face stress=fyb/gammaM0; stress at physical As centroid.
stiffeners.assembly_interpretation: Physical complete compressed lip plus the retained adjacent flange strip, with polygon corners included once; opposite flange/lip wholly tensile, kr=0.
stiffeners.centreline_interpretation: EN13 Eq5.17 centreline stress evaluated at centroid of effective physical As, as in the inherited stiffener-as-column model.

My_negative.ULS_pure_effort_role: Pure moment normalized by retained line/offset faces; NOT a design resistance.
My_negative.effective_centroid_property_origin: Original polygon coordinates; pure-My coefficients use gross-centred coordinates and N=0.
My_negative.fixed_point_statement: Reduced web geometry and ULS field rechecked after convergence; both flange bounds remain exactly integral without lip restraint credit. Translating-junction coupled modes and member stability remain outside this certificate.
My_negative.proof: EN1993-1-5 4.4(4), Eq4.4 and Note1 iteration; Table4.1 uniform web bound and Table4.2 psi=-0.25/k=4.01875 signed free-outstand flange bounds. All line/face vertices, including tensile comparison ordinates, checked at every iteration and finally. EN1993-1-3 6.1.4.1(4) pure moment ULS. No lip restraint, no Eq5.17 negative stress and no service-stress reduction.
My_negative.scope: Normal line stress of this pure component only; not complete section/member resistance.

My_positive.ULS_pure_effort_role: Pure-component line-stress normalization only, NOT a design resistance or exterior-fibre strength.
My_positive.effective_centroid_property_origin: Original pinned polygon coordinates; stress coefficients use gross-centred coordinates.
My_positive.fixed_point_statement: Every local rho=1 and every compressed As has Eq.5.17 As_red/As=1 exactly. Thus geometry, centroid, stiffness and pure ULS stresses remain unchanged on re-evaluation; this is an integral effective-section fixed point.
My_positive.proof: EN1993-1-3 5.5.1(3),5.5.2,5.5.3 and 6.1.3/6.1.4; local slenderness at fyb; integral local widths and exact Eq.5.17 As_red/As=1 required at the pure-component ULS field; chi_d may be below 1 only with this unchanged-section fixed-point witness. No actual-service-stress reduction law and no optional plastic/strength enhancement.
My_positive.scope: Normal line stress of this pure component only; not complete section/member resistance.

stiffeners.assembly_interpretation: For a mixed flange with a compressed lip, Eq.5.10b is applied to the wholly compressed physical As with kr=As2/As1; bounded interpretation, not an exact coupled distortion solution.

N_compression.ULS_pure_effort_role: Pure-component line-stress normalization only, NOT a design resistance or exterior-fibre strength.
N_compression.effective_centroid_property_origin: Original pinned polygon coordinates; sigma_N is uniform in every coordinate origin.
N_compression.fixed_point_statement: Uniform ULS compression determines local widths and As reduction independently of N magnitude or centroid. Steps1-2 are used without optional step3 refinement; this is not an integral effective section.
N_compression.moment_transport: Mx_corr=Mx-N*ey; My_corr=My+N*ex; select flexural branches by corrected signs
N_compression.proof: EN1993-1-3 6.1.3 uniform ULS compression; EN1993-1-5 Table4.1 psi=1 effective web/flange strips; EN1993-1-3 5.5.3.2 steps1-2, Eq5.17 and (12): t_red=t*chi_d only on disjoint physical As retained in local section. Optional step3 omitted. No service-stress reduction.
N_compression.scope: Normal line stress of this pure component only; not complete section/member resistance.
N_compression.sigma_N_contract: sigma_N=N/Aeff,N; no eccentricity or flexural gradient included; external moment transport is mandatory

stiffeners.Eq5_17_reference: Uniform pure compression ULS at fyb/gammaM0 on all retained physical material.
stiffeners.assembly_interpretation: Actual complete lip and only the effective flange strip adjacent to it, including physical polygon corners; uniform fyb ULS, reduced once by chi_d.
